window-1.title: A Map Of Us (AMOU)
window-1.blurb: A living world map where strangers pin their most personal memories — start by eavesdropping on someone's Lisbon street corner, then drop your own pins for your grandmother's address and every side quest you've lived, and watch it quietly turn into the ancestry archive you keep meaning to build.

window-2.title: Dirt — internet culture newsletter
window-2.blurb: It's the newsletter for people who take memes, movies and fandom as seriously as you do — short, sharp dispatches from writers who are online in the good way, and you'll be screenshotting lines from it into your notes app by the second paragraph.

window-3.title: Doctor Pepo's Tonic (Zero-Proof)
window-3.blurb: This one's got apothecary energy — a little spice, a little bitterness, a name fully committed to the bit — and it's exactly the kind of drink worth building a whole evening persona around.

window-4.title: Sight Unseen: Inside a Vintage-Filled NYC Home

window-5.title: Toriei, Cuppage Plaza
window-5.blurb: A brand-new ten-seat yakitori counter buried on the fourth floor of Cuppage Plaza's gloriously time-warped 80s maze — the kind of place you have to hunt for, then smugly tell everyone about.
